items.text: For the second straight day, Ravens listed QB Lamar Jackson as a full participant in practice. He is poised to return after missing three games with ankle injury.
items.why: Full participant Wednesday and Thursday after high-ankle sprain; Rapoport corroborates poised return.
items.implication: Major upgrade for Ravens offense volume and efficiency.
items.opportunity: Unlocks higher target/route share and red-zone for Flowers; boosts Henry carries.

items.text: After limited Wednesday, Patriots listed WR AJ Brown as non-participant Thursday due to ankle and knee injuries. Status for Sunday up in the air; knee flared.
items.why: Knee flare added to ankle; Rapoport sources confirm not practicing, status uncertain. Degenerative history noted by Levitan.
items.implication: Risk of limited snaps or OUT; monitor Friday.
items.opportunity: If OUT/INACTIVE, boosts other NE pass-catchers and Maye checkdowns; reverse if unexpectedly ACTIVE.

items.text: Packers WR Christian Watson left in ambulance for chest injury but returned dramatically to field and contributed to win. Thorman noted visual concern for collarbone.
items.why: Chest injury mid-game; returned heroically. ETR/Thorman flags collarbone look post-game.
items.implication: Played but monitor for lingering effects next week; high toughness signal.
items.opportunity: No immediate snap loss; reverse any handcuff elevates if setback.

items.text: One day after he didn’t practice, Bengals listed WR Ja'Marr Chase as a full participant in today’s practice (ankle/rest).
items.why: DNP Wednesday for ankle/rest; full Thursday. Not expected to miss.
items.implication: Clears path for full WR1 usage vs TEN.
items.opportunity: Maintains high target/route share; no beneficiary shift.

items.text: Zay Flowers is my WR5 this week. Lamar Jackson expected back, and I LOVE what that means for Flowers.
items.why: Lamar unlock in track-meet Bills matchup; efficiency already strong.
items.implication: Start with confidence as high-end WR1/2.

items.text: Seahawks designated RB Jadarian Price for return to practice.
items.implication: Potential depth chart addition; monitor activation window.
items.opportunity: Could compete for carries/snaps behind Walker if activated soon.

items.text: In 2 games since Caleb Williams returned, Colston Loveland averaging 30% target share and 19.2 PPG; leads TE utilization, top-5 finishes both weeks.
items.why: 30% share, elite utilization score post-Williams return.

items.text: Saquon Barkley HATE (RB20) @ WSH; usage concerns, Dameon Pierce to IR backdrop, DNP notes.
items.why: Usage dip concerns + recent DNP/hamstring tightness; Rapoport latest update pending.
items.opportunity: Snap/carry share uncertainty; monitor for role contraction.

items.text: Adam Levitan and Evan Silva: time to move on and move forward with Jonah Coleman in DEN backfield after return leading snaps (50%) and touches; efficiency edges Harvey/Dobbins.
items.why: First game back: 50% snaps, 11 touches, 4.9 YPC vs Harvey 3.6/Dobbins 3.4; 21% 10+ yard runs. Berry 10 Facts aligns.
items.implication: Coleman emerging as primary; downgrade pure volume for Harvey/Dobbins.
items.opportunity: Snap/touch share expansion for Coleman; committee compression.

items.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba truly special: lost OC Klint Kubiak, limited dynamic threats, DCs shading coverage, stadium knows ball going to him—yet ripping 9 more actual fantasy points than opportunity implies.
items.why: Data shows outperforming expected points amid scheme/personnel/coverage adversity.
items.implication: Sustained high-end WR1 production ROS despite environment; efficiency edge.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle is on my HATE list this week. Production hasn’t been there, and Chiefs allowed just ONE TD to opposing WR all season (JSN).
items.why: Poor recent production + elite KC secondary vs WRs.
items.opportunity: Limited routes/targets expected vs tough matchup.

items.text: Derrick Henry LOVE (RB6) @ BUF with Lamar expected back; history and run-defense matchup favor.
items.why: Lamar return + Bills run D vulnerabilities; volume secure.

items.text: Chase Brown LOVE (RB8) vs TEN; due for TD luck in favorable spot.
items.why: TEN run D soft; volume and TD regression positive with Chase full.

items.text: Omarion Hampton HATE (RB34) @ LAR; still looking for real role.
items.why: Limited role clarity despite opportunity; tough LAR matchup.
